title: What came between Battle of Hitotoribashi and Battle of Suriagehara?
question: What came between Battle of Hitotoribashi and Battle of Suriagehara?
claim: 2 documented links lead from Battle of Hitotoribashi (1586) to Battle of Suriagehara (1589): 0 of cause and effect, 2 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.
